panel.title: A1 - failed WebSocket handshakes by source (2 min)

search.query: index=ev_soc event=ws_auth result=failure status_code=401 | timechart span=1m count by src_ip
index=ev_soc event=id_authorize | timechart span=1m count by status
index=ev_soc event=meter_value | eval ratio=round(power_w/(rated_kw*1000),2) | timechart span=1m max(ratio) by cp_id

index=ev_soc event=ws_auth result=success | lookup ev_inventory cp_id OUTPUT ip as expected_ip | where src_ip!=expected_ip | stats count earliest(_time) as first by cp_id src_ip user_agent | convert ctime(first)

search.query: index=ev_soc event=service_health | timechart span=15s max(cpu_pct) max(active_ws)
